video_visual_positioning: Bright beginner tutorial with readable proof lanes, not dark decorative AI wallpaper.
dark_light_rhythm_rule: No more than one dark proof scene in this sample; active tutorial scenes stay L4/L5 with clean bright proof surfaces.

blocked_failure_modes: fake UI text baked into generated visuals

foreground_ui_system: Enterprise AI control console adapted to a bright beginner tutorial: proof lanes, precise data modules, thin focus borders, and clean source frames inherit the selected palette and material system.
caption_system: Bottom safe-zone frosted caption strip with warm white body text, restrained cobalt/teal keyword emphasis, max two lines, 120-180ms fade-in, and no bouncing or persistent glow.
local_readability_treatment: Every text, proof, or data module quiets the background underneath with local blur, reduced brightness, reduced saturation, and feathered edges instead of hard black rectangles.
transition_language: One restrained data-light-rail transition: the outgoing panel dims into a thin data layer, a soft horizontal/diagonal light track passes, and the next panel assembles behind it in 10-14 frames.
sfx_character: Soft panel settle, subtle digital tick, light scanner sweep, short clean lock click, and low energy pulse mixed 12-18dB below narration.
technology_restraint_policy: No game HUD clutter, no English label pile-up, no fake terminal spam, no repeated identical rounded cards, and no more than two prominent motions in one shot.

validation.tone_gate: Generated/support visuals must pass scripts/validate_visual_tone.py before HyperFrames composition.
